disposition.reason: Neighbors appealed a Hyde Park DRB ruling that relocating a 160-foot telecommunications tower is exempt under the Telecommunications Facilities Interim Bylaw; a telecommunications tower is a nonresidential use, not new housing.

evidence.quote: Appellants appealed from a decision of the Development Review Board (DRB) of the Town of Hyde Park
ruling that the relocation of the so-called Village Communication Tower falls within the exemption
to relocate the upper 140 feet of that tower from the village location to its property in the Rural Residential 2 district

judgments.note: Appeal of a DRB decision (municipal) about relocating a telecommunications tower; telecommunications is a nonresidential use, so housing is no and the case is excluded. The houses and mobile homes on page 2 are only the court's analogies.

history.note: Excluded: municipal appeal about a telecommunications tower relocation, not housing.
